formulae.title: Hénon strange attractor
formulae.basic_explanation: A point orbit under the repeated stretch-fold-reflect map H(x,y)=(y+1-ax², bx) converges onto a strange attractor with a self-similar, Cantor-set-like cross-section — the classic 1.4/0.3-parameter Hénon map.

citation.chicago: Peitgen, Heinz-Otto, Hartmut Jürgens, and Dietmar Saupe. 2004. Chaos and Fractals: New Frontiers of Science. New York: Springer.
